implemented_scope: Identity, standard box/Gaussian, three/five point polynomial and optimized approximation weights; periodic or supplied-halo tensor-product filters; shared serial/MPI dynamic LES model IDs.
numerical_changes: Three separable passes rather than a triple stencil sum; roundoff ordering differs
Gaussian common prefactor cancels before normalization
Invalid input preserves caller output; filter ratio bounded to 1..64
input_limits: Ratio 1..64; standard box requires one or even, standard Gaussian even; optimized tables cover 1..10 with pinned fallbacks. Existing normalization, finite-state and EOS guards can reject wide signed approximations.
